source_description: MetaTrader 5 demo EURUSD H1 export; raw file deliberately excluded
timestamp_semantics: UTC bar-open time; a bar close is available only after the bar completes
quality_contract: timestamps parse as UTC, are unique and strictly increasing
OHLC values are finite and positive
high is at least open, low, and close
low is at most open, high, and close
observed_gap_policy: Keep every adjacent observed row as one transition; no interpolation, reset, calendar-time division, or future-gap predictor/filter
